en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small village beneath a steep, forested rocky hill. On the slope stands a church with a tower and several village houses in the foreground. At the top of the hill, partly hidden by trees, are ruins of a medieval castle or monastery complex. The word "Oybin." is printed in red at the upper left, and the number "5288" and a small "20" appear in red at the lower right.
